summary_claims.claim: As passed, prohibits making a companion chatbot available to users under 18 unless it is not foreseeably capable of certain actions

May 2025 version: covered products include companion chatbots that can foreseeably attempt mental health therapy, cause harmful attachment, or manipulate the child, and AI systems that generate social scores, assess emotional state or process biometric information
